cards.task: Describe the first time you met a person who is now a good friend.
youShouldSay: where and when you met, and how you were introduced
what your first impression of this person was
what you did together after that first meeting
and explain why you became good friends

cards.task: Imagine you are speaking to a group of new freshmen. Give them advice about managing their time at university.
youShouldSay: the biggest time-management problem that new students have
two or three practical tips that work for you
what students should do when they have several deadlines at the same time
and explain why time management is so important at university

cards.task: Talk about the pressures that university students face today.
youShouldSay: what kinds of pressure students face (for example, grades, family, money, social media)
which pressure you think is the most serious, and why
how this pressure affects students' health or studies
and explain what students and universities can do to reduce it

cards.task: Describe your idea of a perfect outdoor vacation.
youShouldSay: where you would go and in which season
who you would go with
what activities you would do there
and explain why this would be a perfect vacation for you

cards.topic: Weather and seasons in your city
cards.task: Describe the weather and seasons in your city or hometown.
youShouldSay: what the weather is like in each season (use temperatures in degrees)
which season you like most and which you like least
what activities you enjoy or dislike in different seasons
and explain how the weather affects people's daily lives in your city

cards.task: Talk about your abilities in outdoor activities and sports.
youShouldSay: one outdoor activity or sport you can do well, and how you learned it
one activity you can't do, but wish you could
how you would learn this new skill
and explain why learning new outdoor skills is (or is not) important to you
